detail.longDescription: 📄 « Annotations as Rollouts: Efficient and Scalable Reinforcement Learning for Video MLLMs » hit 88 upvotes on Hugging Face—a sign that its angle on using annotations to replace costly rollouts is resonating with researchers seeking leaner RL for video. https:// huggingface.co/papers/2608.204 92 # AI # MachineLearning # Research
